e2oQualifierTargetsByEvent.rule: per-event narrowing of e2oQualifiers: identity-binding events must bind an exact Subject (a sha), never a Repository

closingReceipt.rule: a receipt.persist closes iteration w only if it binds >=1 consequence produced by an actuation causally downstream of w and inside the receipt's own iteration segment; a consequence may be bound by at most one receipt

o2oHumanTaint.rule: a consumed object with an O2O path over any o2oQualifiers link to a Human (or origin=human) object is a human cause; paths do not enter humanPreEpochAllowedOutputTypes

humanTouch.rule: every object a human.intervene event links under any qualifier (other than episode and originAuthority) is human-touched; the touch is a human cause for a later consumer unless the human act is in the consumer's own episode, strictly before that episode's epoch, and the object is of a humanPreEpochAllowedOutputTypes type (epoch is always the CONSUMER's); a later event consuming a human-touched object has a human causal in-edge, and O2O paths reaching it are human paths; taint propagates transitively through pre-epoch machine events to every object they output, so a pre-epoch hop cannot launder a human-authored next action
humanTouch.crossEpisodeCausality: a causal E2O flow (input/cause consuming an object produced in another episode) is REFUSED CROSS_EPISODE_CAUSALITY (R_missing_authority, AUTHORITY_FAILURE): no single epoch can judge it

freshReobserve.rule: a transition receipt[n] -> reobserve[n+1] -> workorder[n+1] counts only if reobserve[n+1] consumes receipt[n]'s output strictly after it, no other receipt.persist of the episode lies between receipt[n] and workorder[n+1], workorder[n+1]'s iteration segment reaches no observe/reobserve older than receipt[n], no event of that segment after receipt[n] reads (input/cause/subject) a Subject superseded at its position, and every object consumed (input/cause) anywhere in the causal cone of workorder[n+1] back to receipt[n] -- including the reobserve's own inputs and every machine hop -- is receipt[n]'s output, produced strictly after receipt[n], or an Objective/Authority; otherwise the transition is not counted (ALD drops), the episode lists STALE_REOBSERVE (R_not_fed_back, SUBJECT_FAILURE) and an episode with any stale transition is not AUTONOMOUS

postEpochAuthorityChannel.rule: a human.intervene that outputs, modifies or links (any qualifier but episode, or any number of O2O hops in either direction from any object it links, i.e. its whole O2O component) an Objective or Authority opens a human next-action channel through that object; every later non-human event citing it (originAuthority, input, cause) whose epoch precedes the human act (or of another episode) has a human causal edge. An Authority output by a machine event after t0 is the same channel unless that event consumes the pre-declared envelope (an Authority granted at its episode.start), in which case it inherits the envelope's channel

authorizedActuation.rule: every actuation must have a workorder.issue of its own episode among its causal ancestors; an actuation with none is an unleased DO (R_missing_authority) and fails the episode

unattributedCause.rule: a post-epoch input with no producer in the log, consumed in a workorder's decision segment by anything other than observe/reobserve, makes that workorder not self-generated
